content: Kafka consumer groups have two clocks: session.timeout.ms (heartbeat liveness, default 45s) and max.poll.interval.ms (processing progress, default 5min). Slow processing fires the poll clock -> LeaveGroup -> CommitFailedException/UnknownMemberID -> rebalance storms. kafkajs has NO max.poll.interval.ms equivalent (single-threaded; heartbeats emitted during message processing, so slow handlers trip sessionTimeout instead). aiokafka documented pitfall: processing longer than max_poll_interval_ms causes leave-group loops. Spring Kafka blocking retry/backoff suspends poll(); use SeekToCurrent recoverers or non-blocking retries. Eager assignors revoke ALL partitions per rebalance; CooperativeStickyAssignor limits blast radius; static membership (group.instance.id) avoids rebalances on restart.
